test_title: PYST 06: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to improve the bold part of the sentence.

This session is an improvement **rather the previous one**.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence compares two sessions and implies that the current session is better than the previous one.
 
• The phrase "**rather the previous one**" is incorrect and lacks grammatical clarity.
 
• Using "**over**" appropriately indicates a comparison, making the sentence grammatically correct and concise.
 
• Thus, "**over**" is the most appropriate replacement for the bold part of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"This session is an improvement over the previous one."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "best"** – This does not fit the context as the sentence is comparing two sessions, not describing the best quality.
 
• **Option 2: "more good"** – This phrase is grammatically incorrect. "Better" should be used instead of "more good" for comparison.
 
• **Option 3: "very better"** – This phrase is redundant and grammatically incorrect, as "better" already implies improvement.
